summary: Make lock contention actionable without deleting or bypassing locks.

Fixed: Maintenance queue contention identifies the lock path, recorded owner PID/host, operation, supplied task/session IDs and acquisition age; unavailable fields and the absence of a TTL are explicit.
Host updater polling preserves lock diagnostics instead of replacing them with a generic busy message.

Relay contention identifies the actual mutex or file resource and expiry policy. Unix records bounded owner metadata under its existing OS lock; Windows explicitly reports owner fields unavailable from the named mutex API.
